title: Date range
name: dateRange
english: Keep a range of whole calendar days and say whether it is complete and which dates fall in it.

inputs.name: start
inputs.sentence: The first day of the range.

inputs.name: end
inputs.sentence: The last day of the range.

inputs.name: preset
inputs.sentence: A ready-made range such as the last 7 days.

outputs.name: status
outputs.sentence: Whether the range can be used, and why not.

outputs.name: contains
outputs.sentence: Whether a date falls on a day of the range.

outputs.name: daysIn
outputs.sentence: How many days the range covers.

outputs.name: overlaps
outputs.sentence: Whether two ranges share a day.

events.sentence: The person picks the first day.
The person picks the last day.
The person picks a ready-made range.

wraps.concept: isWithinInterval, areIntervalsOverlapping, startOfDay, endOfDay, subDays, differenceInCalendarDays
wraps.adapter: A complete range is a date-fns interval {start, end}; contains, overlaps and daysIn answer what isWithinInterval, areIntervalsOverlapping and differenceInCalendarDays plus one answer, on UTC days.

phrases: pick a start and end date

signals.sentence: This function checks dates against a start and an end by hand.
